acclimatisation.state.meaning: Crew acclimatisation state used to select the basic maximum FDP table; the represented states are acclimatised and unknown.

fdp.duration.meaning: Flight duty period from crew report to the end of the last operating sector, including qualifying pre-operating positioning.

frm_eligibility.safety_performance_maint.meaning: Whether the Table 4 FRM criterion is met: an implemented FRM continuously monitors whether required safety performance is maintained.

operating_sector_count.meaning: Count of operating sectors for the FDP; positioning sectors are excluded.

reference_time.minute_of_day.meaning: FDP start expressed as minute of day at the crew member's reference time; time-zone conversion and reference-time history are not derived here.

documentation_note: Table values and guards are represented directly. The concepts describe symbolic facts; this module establishes no data-input contract or prepared-fact validator. Derivation and provenance of acclimatisation, reference time, FRM status, and person-specific FDP remain shared-domain concerns. The default limit records the source's nine-hour floor; the represented table guards identify the source-supported combinations.
